title: First-principles shared nonlinear-filter Mirror: discoverability, alignment, negative controls
data: Gaussian independently mixed continuous inputs; train/dev/fresh independent seeds; OOD inputs amplitude x1.5; rule labels analytic generated on demand; per-output pooled target standardization
teacher: y_m = (1-gamma) B H_m activation(H_m(Ax+b)) + gamma B_m activation(A_m x+b_m), then shared per-output affine normalization. Teacher weights never passed to student.
mirror: one learnable K-by-H Householder reflection code, sandwich around ReLU/SiLU; one view selected per input
film: learned per-rule per-channel gain g=1+c; tied diagonal pre/post activation
coupled: learned normalized direction u and scalar beta per rule: S=I+beta*u*u^T, applied before and after nonlinearity; exact Mirror at beta=-2
budget_accounting: actual torch.save inference tensor packet plus architecture metadata; fixed presented examples and updates, actual CPU wall and eager forward latency; do not claim equal FLOPs
positive_mechanism_control: gamma=0 teacher weights and true codes inserted into Mirror student; evaluate exact analytic function before training on newly generated dev; not a main training result

primary_screen.precondition: DEV-only excluded-seed pilot: single pilot seed 707 reported comparator dev NMSE >=0.10 in the primary partially aligned condition, so a 10% relative improvement is numerically feasible; remaining seeds unknown

secondary_descriptive: aligned gamma=0; unrelated gamma=1; SiLU; fixed mirror; independent upper; per-task view swap loss and function diversity; OOD; physical runtime/bytes; no selecting hyperparameters from Fresh
quality_semantics: a numerical pass on aligned teacher is positive-oracle evidence only; no general superiority claim; coupled superset may win; numerical FAIL does not prove impossibility
numeric: PyTorch CPU FP32, torch.set_num_threads(1), nonfixed Xeon clocks, batch128 forward timed after 25 warmups in 5x80 blocks; errors normalized by split target variance
seal: Before constructing fresh/OOD samples: freeze code/protocol SHA, complete all 210 train/dev models, write SEAL.json with fresh_generated=false and every checkpoint SHA256. Fresh/OOD only loaded by score command after seal. Revalidate all 210 scores after first evaluation.
stopping: No post-Fresh change to protocol; if any numerical failure halt and record. Do not run confirmation if screening fails.
